tools.name: get_service_options
tools.description: Use first to learn this provider's service scope, required ride facts and local timeZone. Read current published facts; do not assume additional locations. Language defaults to English; pass locale=de for German, without changing timeZone. It gives no price or availability confirmation. Use get_cust

tools.name: get_customer_policy
tools.description: Use after get_service_options and before prepare_offer to retrieve current account, guest-booking and minimum-lead-time rules. Returns observedAt and revalidationRequired: refresh the rules before preparing an offer; no terms-validity window is promised. Review bound waiting and cancellation terms o

tools.name: quote_ride
tools.description: Use after get_service_options to calculate an anonymous price preview for complete ride facts in the provider timeZone. No contact is needed. Resolve missing return or hourly facts before quoting. The calculatedAt preview requires revalidation; no price-validity window is guaranteed. For rate_limite

tools.name: prepare_offer
tools.description: Use only for an explicit offer request with offerRequested=true, complete ride facts and email OR E.164 phone. Creates one unpaid draft and an offer link; the customer reviews bound terms and confirms via checkoutUrl. No charge or booking confirmation. Use quote_ride for price-only questions. Keep s

tools.name: get_offer_status
tools.description: Use to read one existing request with its original submissionId/resumeToken pair within the original 24-hour window. Returns offer state or recorded booking/payment/fulfillment after payment; no pricing call or new business action. For pending, wait retryAfterSeconds and retry that pair. For ambiguo

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "samuelz-chauffeur" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_customer_policy · Private data: quote_ride, get_offer_status · Public sink: prepare_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_customer_policy · Private data: quote_ride, get_offer_status · Public sink: prepare_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
